chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn, from Ibn Muskan, from Abū Baṣīr and al-Ḥalabī, concerning:
A man who does not know whether he has performed ruku' or has not performed ruku'—he said: he should perform ruku'.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man; the person in question

ai.seo_question: What should a person do in salat (prayer) if he doubts whether he performed ruku' while still standing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who doubts, while standing, whether he has performed ruku' in salat (prayer). The ruling is that he should perform ruku', reflecting the jurisprudence of acting to complete the uncertain pillar of the prayer.
